s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent, severe, unilateral headaches with visual aura and refractory to multiple treatments
salient_findings: Unilateral headache with radiation to multiple regions
Refractory to multiple treatments, including triptans and corticosteroids
key_facts: 17-year history of migraine headaches
Right-sided migraine with visual aura
Pain behind the right eye radiating to right frontal, temporal, and suboccipital regions
3 to 4 severe migraines per month lasting 3 to 7 days
Relief only from sumatriptan
Failed trials of acetaminophen, ibuprofen, rizatriptan, methylprednisolone, prednisone, and dexamethasone
Developed new headache pattern in January 2023
Failed treatment with ketorolac, rizatriptan, and dexamethasone taper
Failed treatment with naratriptan, prochlorperazine, acetaminophen, ibuprofen, and diphenhydramine
Unremarkable brain magnetic resonance imaging
Underwent ultrasound-guided right sphenopalatine ganglion block with bupivacaine and dexamethasone

shortlist.label: Chronic Migraine
shortlist.why_kept: 17-year history of migraine headaches, refractory to multiple treatments

shortlist.label: Hemicrania Continua
shortlist.why_kept: Unilateral headache with visual aura, refractory to multiple treatments

shortlist.label: Cluster Headache
shortlist.why_kept: Severe, unilateral headaches with distinct distribution

shortlist.label: Sphenopalatine Ganglion Neuralgia
shortlist.why_kept: Failed treatment with sphenopalatine ganglion block

raw.rationale: The patient has a 17-year history of migraine headaches with a frequency of 3 to 4 severe migraines per month, which aligns with the diagnostic criteria for Chronic Migraine.

rejected.label: Hemicrania Continua
rejected.why: The patient's headache pattern is not continuous, but rather episodic, which does not fit the diagnostic criteria for Hemicrania Continua.

rejected.label: Cluster Headache
rejected.why: The patient's headache does not occur in clusters or cycles, and the pain is not strictly unilateral, which does not fit the diagnostic criteria for Cluster Headache.

rejected.label: Sphenopalatine Ganglion Neuralgia
rejected.why: The patient underwent an ultrasound-guided right sphenopalatine ganglion block, which failed to resolve her symptoms, making this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Status Migrainosus
rejected.why: Although the patient has a prolonged migraine episode, the fact that she has a long history of migraines and the current episode is not significantly different from her previous episodes makes Status Migrainosus a less likely diagnosis.
